about: reelkit.camera: Cam, clip_near and interp_keys on seeded inputs
note: args.cam holds the eight arguments of Cam by name (floats as float.hex() strings, sy null for None). "Cam(**cam)": pos (3,), M (3, 3: the rows right, up, fwd), target, view and scalars = [f, cx, cy, near]. Points are (k, 3) rows, screen points (k, 2). pixel_rays and ground_hit take float64 xs and ys of shape (rows, columns), as kit.picture gives them. clip_near: "none" is [True] where Python returned None (then out has no rows). interp_keys: the keys are the rows of key_t, key_target and key_rest = [dist, yaw, pitch, fov, sy], called with the default ease.
